premise.what_if: What if the protagonist discovers a family secret that reshapes their understanding of belonging?
premise.central_dramatic_question: Can Alice reconcile her idea of her family with the truth?
premise.logline: A reluctant archivist finds a decades-old letter that unwinds the life she thought she knew.

primary_antagonistic_force.motivation: The family's decades-long commitment to protecting its own peace by withholding the truth from its youngest members
primary_antagonistic_force.escalation: As Alice pushes closer to the letter's author, the family closes ranks — each relative offering a different, softer half-truth — until the silence becomes active resistance rather than ambient absence

secondary_pressures: Alice's own instinct to preserve the family's comfort
conflict.lock_in_mechanism: Alice commits to the search the moment she reads the letter's closing paragraph

theme.thematic_premise: The stories we inherit shape us whether we examine them or not
theme.thematic_argument: Choosing to confront an inherited narrative honestly is more costly, and more liberating, than living comfortably inside it — even when the cost is the narrative itself

how_each_arc_tests_theme.Alice: Alice must decide whether to protect the family's comfort or pursue the truth
how_each_arc_tests_theme.Bob: Bob defends the silence; his arc tests whether protection becomes possession

three_dimensions.surface: A quiet, precise archivist who prefers written records to live conversations
three_dimensions.backstory_inner_demons: Lost her mother young; inherited a family whose stories she could never fully trust
three_dimensions.action_under_pressure: Investigates rather than confronts; retreats into research when pressed

weiland_arc.lie_believed: If I don't ask, nothing has to change
weiland_arc.ghost: The day her mother left the archive incomplete and unexplained
weiland_arc.want: To finish her mother's catalogue before she forgets
weiland_arc.need: To separate her life from the family's unresolved inheritance

three_dimensions.surface: The steady uncle, always ready with a reassuring explanation that smooths the room
three_dimensions.backstory_inner_demons: Sealed the archive decades ago and has defended the decision ever since
three_dimensions.action_under_pressure: Intellectualizes, explains, deflects — never raises his voice, never lets a silence settle

weiland_arc.lie_believed: Protection is the deepest form of love
weiland_arc.ghost: The letter he wrote and never sent, still folded in his desk
weiland_arc.want: To keep the family's peace intact for one more generation
weiland_arc.need: To trust that Alice can hold the truth without breaking

scene_cards.scene_goal: Alice discovers the sealed letter in the back of the archive
scene_cards.scene_conflict: Alice must decide whether to open the envelope before logging it
scene_cards.arc_phase: Setup: establish Alice's relationship to the archive
scene_cards.scene_outcome: Alice pockets the letter unopened and leaves

scene_cards.scene_goal: Alice reads the letter at home and decides to investigate
scene_cards.scene_conflict: The letter's closing line forces a reckoning Alice cannot undo
scene_cards.scene_outcome: Alice commits to finding the author

canon_constraints.continuity: Contemporary realism; Test Franchise's own internal consistency is the only canon
